status: Surface creation preconditions, mixed surface views and native flip-primary control role implemented; original applicable Wine conformance still incomplete.
changes: When a system DLL does not expose Draw3, private control calls fall back to the inherited Draw2 API slots and descriptor ABI. Other QI errors remain failures. The actual SDK offsets are compiled as static assertions; current DLL proxy3 observations are compared with Native2 behavior while the direct Native3 E_NOINTERFACE record remains visible.

CreateSurface requires a cooperative level before any descriptor/output validation or write, including NULL descriptions. The legacy entry thunks enforce the same ordering without clearing sentinel outputs. Existing post-cooperative-level validation and allocation rules remain.

D3D7 CreateDevice accepts all five known public surface vtables, resolves their actual interface offset and validates ownership before allocation/transport. Null/foreign-vtable/other-owner inputs remain rejected. Existing constructor failure rollback and multiple-live-device behavior remain.

Prepare the native primary before allocating proxy pixels. Keep the draw view and native primary until publication/rollback, and keep a private proxy owner hold across native callbacks and pixel allocation. Use native creation width/height/pixel format rather than cached current display metadata; preserve logical virtual mode fallback, prevent retired owner resurrection and reject reentrant duplicate primary publication. Native private primary controllers now mirror the requested flip/complex role and backbuffer count in both descriptor layouts, rather than always creating a standalone primary. Native Restore of a lost flip primary is guarded outside exclusive mode to avoid the unsafe XP system call. Native surfaces still never draw or present game pixels.

nativeCreationReference.scope: Independent system DLL, 127 seconds,49 HRESULT/output records; all four supported native views reject primary/system/video/NULL creation before SetCooperativeLevel without changing outputs. Native QueryInterface(DDraw3) returns E_NOINTERFACE and is retained explicitly. Native HEL flip primaries remain valid after NORMAL in this no-SetDisplayMode sequence; no Wine assertion was waived on that basis.

rejectedInitialDiagnostic.scope: Initial native program stopped at unsupported DDraw3; failed completion and raw log retained, runner interrupted. Not accepted or counted as a complete baseline. Final probe records that unsupported view and proceeds with the remaining views, releasing the factory view as frozen Wine does.

comparison.proxyAdditionalViewsReference: Native Draw2 inherited controller API slots and descriptor ABI; direct Native Draw3 QueryInterface remains E_NOINTERFACE. All12 proxy3 observations match Native2 with only the version label remapped.
comparison.scope: Exact48-record comparison for native-supported views1/2/4/7 plus12 proxy3 records against Native2 inherited API behavior. Control/creation only, not complete Wine conformance or a pixel rendering claim.

proxyCreationComparison.scope: Same source with only loader path redirected. Exact comparison of48 HRESULT/output records for native-supported1/2/4/7;12 proxy3 observations match the inherited Native2 control API behavior with only version label remapped. Direct Native3 E_NOINTERFACE is retained, and actual SDK shared controller slot offsets are checked. This is an explicit compatibility fallback, not an original Wine applicability waiver. This control-only probe uses acknowledged transport and makes no graphics pixel claim.
